title: Special Topics in Brazilian Studies; Race, Class and Gender in Brazil
description: This class introduces students to contemporary issues in Brazilian culture and society. It explores how discussions around LGBTQ rights, women's rights, race and social inequality play out in Brazil reshaping its culture and national identity. Taught in English.

instructors: Ana Claudia Dos Santos Sao Bernardo
